_notes: Bridge trench (zone 5). Terrain GLBs carry the slot (floor about y -13, |x|<4.2 bottom, rock walls to |x| 6.5, z 6.5-21). Layout group WorldTrench lines the walls with embedded boulders/ledges and the floor with fallen blocks; trench_lava plane (Assets/Env/World/Trench/trench_lava) fills the floor at y -12.6. Needs Unity-side work below.
colliders: invisible box colliders along both deck edges (x = +-4.6, z 5.5..22) wherever there is no parapet, height 1.2 m, so the player cannot fall in

lavaMaterial.note: orange-red, hot cores yellower; pools break the crust

lights.note: wall wash left, lifts the glow up the wall

glowGradientTarget: glow reaches about a third of the wall height (y about -9), fading to black by y about -5; raise/lower intensity until the player capture matches. Range values are generous so the falloff, not the cutoff, sets the gradient.
darkening: Local Volumetric Fog (box center [0,-6,14], size [14,14,16]) with near-black albedo (sRGB 10) and a vertical gradient: density low at the bottom (glow shows), high toward the top (walls go black near the deck); keeps the gradient glow at the bottom, black near the top. Alternative: a single dark gradient mesh is NOT needed.
supports: Bridge kit (world_build/bridge_kit, from the helper) is placed in layout group WorldBridge when it lands; assumed deck underside y about -0.5 (Unity dev: confirm deck TOP/UNDERSIDE y).
editorScript: Assets/Editor/HdrpTrench.cs (HdrpTrench.Run, menu Hades/World/Apply trench setup, log tag HDRPTRENCH); the "deckBlockers", "lights", "fog", "triplanar" keys are read by it, the rest is documentation
